name: Wandering Trainers
description: Sprinkles eight optional battle trainers across the towns (Viridian, Pewter, Cerulean, Vermilion, Celadon, Lavender, Fuchsia, Cinnabar). Each is a townsperson who ASKS if you'd like to battle (YES/NO) before fighting, with level-appropriate parties and a rematch greeting once beaten. No engine files touched, no maps edited.
